title: BARAAT AARAHI HAI IBNE HASAN KI RAN SE
body:
BOLI SAKINA ROOKER KHAIMEIN MEIN YEH DULHAN SE
BARAAT AARAHI HAI IBNE HASAN KI RAN SE
1. TASHNADAHAN BARATI TASHNADAHAN HAI DULHA
THI BEWATAN KI SHAADI GURBAT MEIN BEWATAN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
2. QASIM KA JISM ME ATHER PAMAAL HOGAYA HAI
KUBRA DULHAN KE BAZOO BANDH JAYENGE RASAN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
3. KEHTI THI UMME FARWA MASNAD BICHAAO FIZZA
DULHA KO LAA RAHE HAI SHABBIR JAAKE RAN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
4. QASIM K TAN KE TUKDE LAYA HOON MEIN ABAA MEIN
RO RO KE SHAHE WALA KEHTE THE YEH BAHEN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
5. KYA SOUNCH KAR NA JAANE THARRAIEE LAASHE QASIM
HOKER ASEER GUZRE AHLE HARAM JO BAN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
6. ROKEGA KAISE HUM KO YEH INQELAAB E DUNIYA
WA BASTA HUM RAHENGE AKBER KI ANJUMAN SE
<<DIVIDER>>
7. PHOOLE PHALE JAHAN MEIN QASIM MOHIB TUMHARE
MAZHER KI YEH DUA HAI MABOOD E PANJETAN SE
AZZ..MAZHER ABEDI
